run_compression_tests: run the gRPC aio compression unit tests to verify compression behavior
test_channel_level_compression: test channel-level compression with Gzip disabled and Deflate allowed on insecure channels
test_client_call_compression: test client call-level compression by setting Gzip or Deflate on individual RPC calls
test_server_set_compression: test server-side set_compression to switch to Deflate compression on stream responses
test_disable_next_message_compression: test server disable_next_message_compression to skip compression on specific unary or stream messages
